review: Read-only source contracts for saved-neural-output to full CPU mesh conversion
decision: Source guidance only; candidate execution review pending

official_source.comparison: Requested official main source was read online and compared with the preserved installed source. Relevant inference offsets, split-weight rule and final grid/AABB transform agree; full files are not identical.

decoder_feature_contract.coordinates: Use saved coordinates[:,1:] directly, preserving original row and axis order; no D/H/W permutation
decoder_feature_contract.split_weight: softplus(features[:,6:7]), supplied for this inference path; preserve float32 values and products
decoder_feature_contract.world_vertex: (coordinates+dual_vertex)/512-0.5, using saved artifact resolution512 and AABB[-0.5,0.5]^3
decoder_feature_contract.resolution_caveat: Checkpoint configuration says256, but saved actual output provenance and full support are512. Do not copy the checkpoint's geometry resolution into this approved saved-output conversion.
decoder_feature_contract.margin_caveat: The configured default margin permits dual vertices[-0.5,1.5] and world positions up to half a voxel outside nominal AABB: generic bound[-0.5009765625,0.5009765625]. Do not clamp or reject against nominal[-0.5,0.5].

triangulation.selection: Choose split1 iff q0*q2>q1*q3; equality chooses split2. Float32 product underflow can create genuine ties; float64 comparison can change topology.
triangulation.winding: Preserve these ordered indices. On canonical planar cells the normal points toward the negative coordinate axis for all three groups. Source does not flip winding using a sign or automatically orient an outward solid.
triangulation.order: intersected_flag boolean indexing selects row-major(voxel original row,axis) quads. Emit both ordered triangles for each valid quad; chunking must not reorder vertices or change global original indices.

global_lookup: Sort integer coordinate keys only for membership search; map successful search positions back through the sort permutation to ORIGINAL saved row indices. Keep every original vertex, including unused rows. A quad exists only if all four distinct coordinate queries are present. Explicitly range-check each query axis before linearizing to prevent z/y carry alias at512; native out-of-range behavior is not established by the Python source alone. Never clamp a query, reuse a missing index or fill a missing corner.
reference_differences: Installed converter adds device-aware statics, triangle chunks and an optional overlapping tiled helper. For this global conversion use the common nontraining, supplied-split-weight core. The official early vertices expression involving2*N is overwritten by the actual inference grid/AABB branch; do not use it. Training midpoint construction and the split_weight=None angle fallback are outside this artifact contract.
acceptance_caveats: Report selected flags, valid quads, missing-any-corner quads, out-of-grid queries and exactly2*valid_quads triangles. Source retains geometrically degenerate triangles and unused vertices; no automatic deletion, weld, hole filling, simplification or winding repair is source-equivalent. Finite valid indexed geometry alone does not prove watertightness, manifoldness, lack of self-intersections or visual quality. Diagnose boundary/nonmanifold/degenerate counts without inventing missing geometry.
